title: axross built-in catalog
description: Images pinned by digest - Docker's curated mcp/* namespace on Docker Hub, and GitHub's own image on ghcr.io - and npm/PyPI packages pinned to an exact version, built into a container. Digests were read from the registries' manifests and versions from npm and PyPI (2026-10-25; the 2026-10-28 reference releases, GitHub, Playwright, MarkItDown, Brave Search and DuckDuckGo on 2026-11-03).

entries.name: git
entries.title: Git (Reference)
entries.description: Git repository interaction: status, diff, log, show, add, commit, branches. The chosen repository is mounted at /repo; tools take repo_path "/repo". Read-only unless write is allowed.
entries.license: MIT / Apache-2.0 (upstream licence transition: older code MIT, new contributions Apache-2.0)
entries.notes: This is Docker's mcp/git image of 2025: the PyPI package mcp-server-git needs the git program, which the runtime image for PyPI packages does not have.

mounts.description: The git repository the server works on

entries.name: filesystem
entries.title: Filesystem (Reference)
entries.description: Read, search and (with write allowed) change files in the chosen folders only. Each folder appears as /projects/<folder name>.
entries.license: MIT / Apache-2.0 (upstream licence transition: older code MIT, new contributions Apache-2.0)

mounts.description: A folder the server may reach

entries.name: github
entries.title: GitHub (official)
entries.description: GitHub's own MCP server: repositories and their files, issues and pull requests through the GitHub API. Its arguments make it read-only and limit it to the toolsets repos, issues and pull_requests; drop --read-only or change --toolsets to allow more. Needs a GitHub personal access token (kept in the keyring) and network to api.github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com (file contents).

env.name: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: A GitHub personal access token; a fine-grained one with read access to the repositories the agent may see is enough for read-only

entries.name: markitdown
entries.title: MarkItDown (Microsoft)
entries.description: Converts documents to Markdown: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, ZIP, images (metadata) and more. The chosen folders appear read-only as /workdir/<folder name>; give the tool a URI like file:///workdir/<folder name>/report.pdf. Without network it converts only those files and data: URIs.

mounts.description: A folder with documents to convert

entries.name: fetch
entries.title: Fetch (Reference)
entries.description: Fetches a URL from the internet and extracts its contents as markdown. Refuses private, loopback and link-local addresses. Needs network: Full, or Allowlist with the hosts it may fetch from.
entries.license: MIT / Apache-2.0 (upstream licence transition: older code MIT, new contributions Apache-2.0)

entries.name: playwright
entries.title: Playwright (Microsoft)
entries.description: A headless Chromium the model drives through the page's accessibility tree: open pages, click, type, fill forms, take snapshots and screenshots. The browser profile is kept in memory only (--isolated). Needs network: Full (Chromium does not go through the Allowlist proxy).
entries.notes: A browser is heavy for axross's container limits (512 MB memory, 128 processes, 64 MB /tmp): large pages can fail there.

entries.name: brave-search
entries.title: Brave Search (official)
entries.description: Web, news, image, video and local search through the Brave Search API, and its AI summaries. Needs a Brave Search API key (kept in the keyring) and network to api.search.brave.com.

env.name: NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY
env.description: 1: Node's fetch uses axross's allowlist proxy (without it the server reaches nothing under Allowlist)

entries.name: duckduckgo
entries.title: DuckDuckGo Search (community)
entries.description: Web search through DuckDuckGo's HTML page, no API key, and a tool that fetches a result page as text. Not published by or affiliated with DuckDuckGo. Needs network: Full (the fetch tool reaches any host).

entries.name: memory
entries.title: Memory (Reference)
entries.description: A knowledge graph the model can write to and read back: entities, relations, observations. By default it lives in the container's /tmp; to keep it, mount a folder at /data, allow write and set MEMORY_FILE_PATH to /data/memory.jsonl.
entries.license: MIT / Apache-2.0 (upstream licence transition: older code MIT, new contributions Apache-2.0)

env.name: MEMORY_FILE_PATH
env.description: Where the graph is stored inside the container (its folder must be writable)

mounts.description: A folder for a graph that is kept

entries.name: sequentialthinking
entries.title: Sequential Thinking (Reference)
entries.description: Step-by-step, revisable problem solving through a sequence of thoughts.
entries.license: MIT / Apache-2.0 (upstream licence transition: older code MIT, new contributions Apache-2.0)

entries.name: time
entries.title: Time (Reference)
entries.description: The current time in a time zone and conversion between time zones. The container's own zone is UTC; to change it, set the argument --local-timezone=Europe/Berlin (an exact IANA name).
entries.license: MIT / Apache-2.0 (upstream licence transition: older code MIT, new contributions Apache-2.0)

entries.name: everything
entries.title: Everything (Reference test server)
entries.description: The MCP test server: echo, add, environment, long-running operations, images and resources - for trying a client, not for work.
entries.license: MIT / Apache-2.0 (upstream licence transition: older code MIT, new contributions Apache-2.0)

entries.name: vuln-nist
entries.title: Vuln NIST (NVD / CVE lookups)
entries.description: Queries NIST's National Vulnerability Database: CVEs by id, keyword or CPE, CISA KEV entries, CVE change history. No API key needed. Needs network to services.nvd.nist.gov.

entries.name: shodan
entries.title: Shodan (Cyreslab)
entries.description: Shodan host, service, SSL and IoT search. Needs a Shodan API key (kept in the keyring) and network: Full.
entries.notes: Allowlist does not work for this image: its HTTP client (axios 1.8.4) sends https requests to a proxy as plain GET instead of CONNECT, which axross's allowlist proxy refuses. It only talks to api.shodan.io.

entries.name: rea
entries.title: REA - Reverse Engineer Anything
entries.description: Reverse engineering for agents: JavaScript and Electron apps, .NET assemblies, websites and native binaries. In axross's container the static JavaScript/Electron analysis works on its own; native analysis needs Hopper, Ghidra or IDA, which the container does not have. Files to analyse are mounted at /work.
